text:
Lena.AE: Ran into a new ask from MeridianHealth POC. They want to run ember-30b (upstream) inside their private VPC with customer HSM (PKCS#11) and KV prefix caching. Target load ~10 qps sustained. Need quick compatibility checklist, rough onboarding timeline, and a 10 qps cost ballpark. Any immediate blockers?

Diego.SE: Short answer: ember-30b uses RMSNorm + fused attention; grouped_gemm kernels improve perf. We can serve a q8_0 quant but runtime needs the grouped_gemm kernel patch in v2.5+. If their infra can't get the patched container, latency may be higher.

Sam.ML: Estimate for hands-on model work: model export + quantize + compile + smoke perf = 2 business days. KV prefix caching supported up to ~2048 tokens; for longer prefixes we'd discuss kv-shard changes (+1 day). If they want, we can offer ember-lite (~13B distilled) as a lower-cost option.

Priyanka.Infra: On-prem/VPC preflight: NVIDIA driver >=525, CUDA >=12.1, container runtime >=1.6, and PKCS#11 libs present. If they're air-gapped we can provide an image tarball. I'll open infra-valid ticket once they send `nvidia-smi` and `ldconfig -p` output.

Ravi.Security: We support BYO HSM via PKCS#11 using our KMS shim in Private. Required docs: completed security questionnaire, network/dataflow diagram, SOC2 Type II, and signed DPA. If they require zero-egress model residency, confirm keywrap behaviour and storage encryption at rest.

deploy-bot: INF-9901 created: infra validation + driver check. Commands for customer to run:
```
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv
./validate_cuda.sh --min=12.1
ldconfig -p | grep pkcs11 || echo "pkcs11 missing"
```

Diego.SE: Cost note: hosted 4x H100s equivalent ~ $420/hr platform (rough); Private adds platform license + managed ops. I'll prepare a 10 qps cost calc for both Dedicated and Private.

Sam.ML: Timeline: assuming infra checks pass — 2 days for conversion/quantize/compile, 1 day KV perf tuning, 1 day integration/docs, plus 1-2 days for canary/rollout. Total ~5-6 business days.

Lena.AE: Action items: I'll request env dump (nvidia-smi + ldconfig), the filled RFI, and confirm whether they prefer Dedicated vs Private. Diego please draft the SOW/costs; Sam tentatively reserve 2 days for conversion. Ravi I'll DM the security questionnaire template. Thanks :thumbsup:

Diego.SE: Will do. If they lean Dedicated we can shorten infra work but pricing will differ significantly. Ping me with their infra dump.

Sam.ML: FYI if they need lower memory we can push a 16-bit float variant (mixed-precision) but may need extra perf tuning.

Lena.AE: Perfect — updating the customer now.
